All trading flow of was going through this after it successfully replaced the previous vendor product. Complete with pre trade risk checks and a complex real time risk tracking with the integrated Fuse system, it achieve an average 99 percentile latency of 100us round trip, excluding exchange trip time. Developed in Java. Eventually hired a team of 4 to help scale to all Asia markets.

2014 - TSE Hirei Haibun System for Nomura Group                   (Nomura Securities Japan) Managed and developed the New Hirei Haibun System project from start to finish ( as part of the larger Fidessa JMIS Decom initiative) This very high visibility process is used every day within Nomura for both Wholesale and Retails to obtain TSE information about stop prices and order info at the auction of the end of market day.  Project is now finished and scheduled to go live on Oct 15th. I handled all its aspects: * gathering requirements and TSE specifications * software implementation of the Arrowhead protocol for Hire Haibun and the rest of the Hirei Haibun app * organize and execute the TSE certification of this new app * coordinate the setup of the production platform, starting from obtaining the physical hosts, dispatch tasks to infra, unix and network teams for patching, software install, firewall and security setups * coordinate with the existing JMIS system support person to understand the existing system so that the new app could fit right in without further changes to downstream systems * coordination with the TSE link team to obtain TSE trading related resources like virtual servers * organized weekend testing and coordinated the execution for the test with TSE, QPS, AES, PMO, JMIS teams * SIT testing ( AES, QPS, ORC, JMIS teams ), obtain business approval from execution desk and business * create all necessary change management tickets for weekend testing, go live, produce release document, run-book document for RTB * overseen the parallel production run of this app with the existing JMIS system * coordinate the golive process  2013 - Naked Access DMA TSE product SPAN Avenger CHIXOE     (Nomura Securities Japan) Managed and developed project for Big Hedge fund, from communication with PMO, information gathering, feedback to client testing, CHIXOE specification analyzing, software development, driving UAT host setup with Unix and Networks teams, obtaining SIT sign off and getting the platform ready for the golive planned on Feb 21st.  2012 - QPS Asia Distributed Risk project          (Nomura Securities Japan) Implement distributed risk tracking for all our trading platforms. Compliance requires us to manage risk in real time and in a distributed manner for all clients that trade on several exchanges at the same time on multiple QPS platforms.  Another goal is to have an integrated code base between US and AS for risk management.  Target platforms: AS NXTDirect TSE, NXTD CHIX, NXTC TSE, CHIX, Japan Next   2012 - NXTD Avenger SBIJ OUCH Go Live       (Nomura Securities Japan) - Main developer for the SBIJ OUCH exchange platform for NXTD Avenger ( SPAN, naked access ) - Responsible with the development of the OUCH transport as well as tools required by RTB to handle different situations in production environment. - Project successfully went live on Feb 2013 and is being used by one of our biggest clients.  2009 – 2014:     NXT Connect Trading Platforms                      (Nomura Securities Japan)

Description:  Nomura’s next generation sub-m (under 1 ms round trip latency) DMA product. Built in anticipation to the big bang TSE arrowhead go-live from Jan 2010, this was the fastest platform on the market at that time, allowing Nomura brokerage and my team QPS to capture as much as 20% of the daily TSE cash orders volume soon. Using advanced Java techniques, it achieved an average round trip latency of 400 microseconds.  Features: a fast fix engine for client connections, protocol translation, a rules engine, comprehensive real time risk checks for position, availability, gross trading amount, credit limit checks, max order value, tick sizes, lot sizes, static data, intraday corporate actions updates, front office risk view, downstream offloading modules, failover capabilities, exchange colocation, in memory mapped order flow persistence, flow analytics frameworks for latency analysis, market data. Different transports (line handlers) were written to connect our clients to several other exchanges (CHIX FIX, native ASX & OSE OMS, and native TSE arrowhead). The platform allowed clients to connect using FIX protocol which was translated to the native exchange protocol. For TSE, was part of the team who delivered the Arrowhead go-live product, with main responsibilities on the arrowhead transport, rules engines and risk checks implementation. Post TSE go-live, was the main lead for supporting the platform, bug fixes, new features development (for example TSE IOC, round robin session selection strategies) For CHIX and ASX was the main developer for the exchange transports and conducted and passed the exchange certification with the platform. It is currently the main trading DMA platform of Nomura and several other teams started using it. Keywords: Java, C, FIX, Arrowhead, OMX, ASX, CHIX, OSE, in-memory, garbage collection, priming  2010-2014:     RAGG  (real time risk aggregator)                            (Nomura Securities Japan) Description: RAGG is a multi-exchange multi-client real time risk aggregator system, mandatory for compliance reasons, which brings a new paradigm for tracking risk data in near real time. It allowed us to remove real time risk checks reducing the latency by around 100 micro-sec (30%). This project had high visibility at compliance level and was used to track risk breaches for position and availability for several clients trading on multiple exchanges and trading platform flavors (avenger, nxtc, tse, chix) and raise alerts or take action to stop trading if there were risk limits breaches. It did that by merging the risk data sources based on timestamps and simulate local replays of orders and executions. RAGG came to the rescue when we had the first client that traded on both TSE and CHIX exchanges at the same time and we had to prove to compliance that we correctly track position and availability risk values over both exchanges. RAGG now is being used by business to monitor risk for TSE and CHIX for all flavors of trading platforms. I was the only developer for this system. Keywords: Java, memory mapped files, concurrent skip list map, threading, garbage collection, near real time, multi flow time line aggregation, risk replay, flow persistence, multi trading platform 2010:     NXT Direct Trading Platforms                      (Nomura Securities Japan) Description:  Avenger (0 micro-sec naked access with chasing cancels) and FPGA (3 micro-sec with real time risk checks) for TSE and CHIX. Avenger is the next iteration trading platform than allowed collocated clients who could speak the native exchange protocol to connect through Nomura with no latency. Mandatory risk checks were enforced by chasing cancels for Arrowhead TSE. The flow was offloaded by Avenger from the wire by employing a technique of TCP packet reconstruction in C. Communication with the Java layer was made using shared memory ring buffers.

FPGA was the hardware based Nomura solution for TSE arrowhead. The FPGA board is doing real time risk checks and could also offload data to an Avenger like C-Java system for further processing and downstream feeding. I was developer for the Avenger solution and consultant for the FPGA working closely with the hardware team to integrate.
